summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement on July 30, 2026, to acquire 270 shares of Sarborg Limited (approx. 4.76% of outstanding common stock) from certain stockholders. Consideration is pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 12,131,770 CDT shares at $0.0001 per share, exercisable only after stockholder approval per Nasdaq rules (19.99% cap). CDT will file a resale registration statement within 60 days of closing. The deal includes customary reps, warranties, and mutual indemnification. Watch for stockholder approval and Nasdaq compliance as key conditions.
